params.message: Use your ask_user tool to ask me one multiple-choice question: tea or coffee? Then reply with just my answer.

details.name: ask_user
details.label: Ask User
details.description: Ask the human user 1-3 structured questions and wait for their answer; `multiSelect` allows picking several options and `timeoutSeconds` bounds the wait. Use only when blocked on a decision genuinely theirs that cannot be resolved from the request, code, or sensible defaults; never ask whether to proceed or confirm a plan. Ask exactly one question per call unless several answers must be submitted together; one single-select question uses native controls on supported messaging channels. Put every selectable choice in `options`, never only in the question text. Put the recommended option first and suffix its label with ` (Recommended)`. Use `multiSelect` only when the user may choose several options at once; otherwise omit it. Do not include an Other option; free text is added automatically. If the result is no_answer, continue with best judgment.
details.input: { questions: Array<{ header: string; id: string; options: Array<{ label: unknown; description?: unknown; preview?: unknown; resourceUri?: unknown; thumbnail?: unknown; value?: unknown }>; question: string; multiSelect?: boolean }>; timeoutSeconds?: number /* integer */ }

header.description: Short chip label; longer input is truncated to 12 characters.

question.description: Single-sentence question only. Put all selectable choices in options.

options.description: Every selectable choice. Put the recommended choice first; do not repeat choices only in the question text.

multiSelect.description: True only when the user may choose several options at once.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum human wait in seconds; default 900, clamped 30-3600. Earlier run cancellation or overall run timeout still applies.

Ask exactly one question per call unless several answers must be submitted together; one single-select question uses native controls on supported messaging channels. If the result is no_answer, continue with best judgment.
tool.input: { questions: Array<{ header: string; id: string; options: Array<{ label: unknown; description?: unknown; preview?: unknown; resourceUri?: unknown; thumbnail?: unknown; value?: unknown }>; question: string; multiSelect?: boolean }>; timeoutSeconds?: number /* integer */ }
